title: Line Ceiling Share by FBN Program for Inbound-Shortage Approvals
content:
The line ceiling share applied to the units expected on an inbound-shortage case's shipment line is the large-program line ceiling share of 15% (0.15) for an enrollment in FBN Scale Program, FBN Premier Program or FBN Enterprise Program, and the mid-program line ceiling share of 10% (0.1) for an enrollment in FBN Core Program or FBN Growth Program. An enrollment in FBN Starter Program is not given a share by this schedule.

These are Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) program figures, read from the program the enrollment is in on the handling date; the units expected are those declared for the case's shipment line.

| Program | Line ceiling share |
|---|---|
| FBN Enterprise Program | 15% |
| FBN Premier Program | 15% |
| FBN Scale Program | 15% |
| FBN Growth Program | 10% |
| FBN Core Program | 10% |
| FBN Starter Program | not given by this schedule |

Illustration (hypothetical line of 240 units expected): 15% is 36 units in FBN Scale Program; 10% is 24 units in FBN Core Program.
